prior_exposure: All original, secant, and critical confirmation outcomes are known. This is additional cost accounting, not a replacement for their frozen capped comparisons.
objective: Run the strong original linear-adjoint tilt to the sample count implied by each available variance certificate, rather than report its variance at another method's path count as though that met the same confidence target.
method: Same recorded 32-bit original linear proposal. Counts chosen solely from already recorded rigorous second-moment certificates: ceil((exp(logK)-1)/(0.05*0.05^2)), rounded up to 256. Main derivative and secant certificates use one new stream with prefixes at their respective predetermined counts. No adaptive stopping based on outcomes.
cost_reporting: Full measured new stream cost plus separate recorded acquisition/certificate costs. Prefix sampling cost is proportional allocation, explicitly labeled; no fabricated standalone timing. Preserve all failed claims and original path-cap results.
privacy: Private; root local computation, no extra workers, no Ultra allocation.
